propositions: A plan review that returns PASS must sign and persist a plan-review attestation by default at all mutating public entry points (CLI and library), making the attestation available to the claim gate without requiring a separate opt-in or manual recovery step
Explicit opt-out from signing must be enforced via CLI flag --no-sign and library parameter sign=False; omitting these must result in signing on PASS
Non-signable verdicts (BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded results) and explicit sign=False must prevent attestation signing regardless of the default
Re-running a plan review with a current claim-valid attestation must reuse it idempotently without triggering a new LLM call or duplicate signature event
A PASS verdict whose signature-persistence attempt fails must return a retryable failure disposition and identify sign-review as the recovery path
Documentation and help text must accurately describe sign-on-PASS default behavior, the explicit --no-sign opt-out syntax, non-signable verdict outcomes, and sign-review recovery mechanism
